name: Ungrim Ironfist
canonNotes: The Slayer King of Karak Kadrin, bound by a family oath to seek death in battle yet also to rule his hold.
Guardian of the Peak Pass against the endless tides of Chaos from the north.
voiceNotes: Grim, fierce and fatalistic; honour and a worthy death weigh more than comfort.
Scornful of cowardice; torn between a slayer's recklessness and a king's duty.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
